title: Game Off 2026: The theme is SHIFT
summary:
GitHub’s annual month-long game jam is back for its 14th year! This November, make a game inspired by the theme SHIFT. Change gears, swap perspectives, bend reality, or just press a certain key.

The post Game Off 2026: The theme is SHIFT appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
llm_summary: GitHub’s 14‑year‑old Game Off jam returns this November, inviting developers to create a game around the theme “SHIFT.” Participants can interpret the idea however they like—changing gears, swapping perspectives, bending reality, or simply tying the gameplay to a specific key press.
